reviews.title: Update on Support - BEWARE!!!!
reviews.text: Update (8/21/26) - With the issues I had accessing the account in February, I cancelled my subscription and received an email on 2/15/2026 stating my account had been cancelled but due to the issues I experienced Lasta was extending my access to the app. Then, on July 31, 2026, Lasta took $55.82 for renewal and refused to return due to their “no refund policy”! Since they shouldn’t have taken it to begin with it shouldn’t be considered a refund!!!! My account had already been cancelled for 5 months!!!!

reviews.title: Great customer service

Because I was unable to use the program when I first enrolled, Lily provided me extra time to be able to use it. Lily’s customer service was great! She sets a high bar!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: This app is not worth the money; I used it for over a month and the workouts I did had errors in the verbal instructions that did not match the demonstrator, repetitive ineffective movements, among other issues with loading the app in general. BODi is a much better value and the workouts are much more effective and entertaining. Very disappointed I wasted my money on this.

reviews.title: Caution with expensive Charges
reviews.text: Initially signed up for 30 day at discounted price and not once was I notified that after a month, I would be charged $91.25 for 2 monthly subscription. I contacted customer service and requested refund. Instead I was offered 2 months of additional access to app. I declined this offer because I did not even use the first month. I continued to ask for refund, their customer service proceeded to suspend the access to the app and did not refund the charges. Recent emails were sent to their customer service and no response. USE CAUTION BECAUSE THEY WILL CHARGE YOU ALMOST A HUNDRED DOLLARS!

reviews.title: Fantastic Customer Service!

Not only did they reply in a timely and frequent manner to check how it was working, but they even sent me a PDF so that I wouldn’t miss a day. Thank you Lisa West and everyone behind the scenes for your outstanding customer service!

reviews.title: easy workouts for people who have not worked out in years
reviews.text:
I saw the commercial for the app, and I downloaded the my personal challenge the military calisthenics. I have to admit I thought they were not gonna do much. For the time that is states you do your workouts, but it is true that if you do the workouts, you will feel the burn and people will start to notice. I have lost 30 pounds so far by doing the workout the 28 day calisthenics they also have the walking tai chi and many other workouts for you to choose from . At the end of my subscription, it did not renew. I kept going to the App Store to see if it was in an absence why it didn’t renew, but it wouldn’t show up in the App Store. 

I reached out to the support team. and received your response from William Miller. Who looked into what happened? He was able to assist me and get my app back up and working. I also received a follow up email from Mary to ensure that I had the correct links in order to post my experience with the app and the support teams help which was great. I appreciate them getting me back into the app so that I can continue my weight loss journey. 

Shanda Douglas
